title: Faith, Hope, Love
subtitle: FHL - Internal Project
description: The Faith Hope Love Clinic Website is an online healthcare information and service platform designed to provide patients with convenient access to clinic information, medical services, and communication channels. The system serves as a centralized digital interface that enables users to explore available healthcare services, learn about the clinic, and easily connect with medical professionals.

title: GFMIC E-Commerce
subtitle: GFMIC - E-Commerce Platform
description: The GFMIC e-commerce platform is a centralized digital system designed to manage, promote, and distribute official GFMIC merchandise efficiently. It serves as a one-stop online hub where members and customers can easily browse, select, and purchase a wide range of GFMIC products, ensuring accessibility and convenience anytime and anywhere.

title: GFMIC Academy
subtitle: GFMIC - Learning Management System
description: The GFMIC Learning Management System integrated with the Mentorship & Peer Matching System is a web-based platform designed to centralize and enhance digital learning and mentorship processes. It provides a structured environment where instructors can create and manage courses, upload learning materials, conduct assessments and monitor student progress, while students can conveniently access content, complete activities and track their performance.

title: YO-etz AI Interview
subtitle: AI-Assisted Interview System
description: The AI-Assisted Initial Interview System is a structured digital pre-interview platform designed to support and enhance the admissions process of the Polytechnic University of the Philippines ICC and Cabuyao campuses. The system standardizes how applicant interviews are conducted by providing a controlled environment for structured and semi-structured questioning, ensuring consistency, fairness, and documentation across all academic programs.

title: StewardFM
subtitle: Facility Management System
description: StewardFM is a comprehensive facility management system designed to streamline operations, maintenance tracking, and resource allocation for organizations. It provides an intuitive dashboard for managing assets, scheduling maintenance tasks, and generating insightful reports for facility administrators.

title: PUP Smart-Track
subtitle: Smart Tracking System
description: PUP Smart-Track is an intelligent tracking and monitoring system developed for the Polytechnic University of the Philippines. It enables real-time tracking of academic progress, student activities, and institutional resources through a centralized digital platform.

title: Bitbo AI
subtitle: AI-Powered Platform
description: Bitbo AI is an artificial intelligence-powered platform that leverages machine learning and natural language processing to deliver intelligent automation solutions. The system is designed to assist users with data analysis, content generation, and decision-making processes.

title: Flor De Grace
subtitle: Business Management System
description: Flor De Grace is a business management system designed to streamline operations for small to medium enterprises. It provides tools for inventory management, customer relationship management, sales tracking, and financial reporting through an integrated digital platform.

title: SRG Website
subtitle: Organization Portfolio
description: The SRG Website serves as the official digital presence of the Software Research Group. It showcases the organization's projects, team members, leadership structure, and provides contact information for interested parties and potential collaborators.
